build_JEPA_unroll: build a JEPA model and call unroll with parallel mode to predict multi-step future states
run_JEPA_infer: run JEPA inference on observations and actions to produce single-step predictions in parallel
create_JEPAProbe_head: create a JEPAProbe with a frozen JEPA encoder and trainable prediction head for downstream tasks
test_JEPAbase_encode: test the JEPAbase encode method to encode a sequence of observations into latent states
review_JEPA_unroll_autoregressive: review the JEPA unroll method in autoregressive mode for step-by-step planning with sliding context window
